title: security: rbac-v2 + KMS region pinning audit hardening (enforce & telemetry)
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Harden RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS-backed secrets and introduce region pinning audit events so compliance teams can verify data residency guarantees. This PR contains: 1) enforcement toggle and migration from audit-only to enforce for KMS region pinning policies, 2) audit log enrichment with KMS key residency and evaluated policy id, 3) RBAC v2 policy evaluation path fixes to ensure service principals cannot bypass residency constraints via fallback routing, 4) migration script to backfill existing resources with evaluated_kms_region metadata, and 5) integration tests + e2e smoke tests and docs for operators.

Changeset summary: the change is intentionally split across small focused commits: policy evaluation refactor, audit log schema change, migration job, API surface guards, and operator docs. There is a feature flag (rbac_v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning) defaulting to "audit" in this release; ops can flip to "enforce" once migration completes.

Checklist:
- [x] Policy evaluation refactor implemented
- [x] Audit log enrichment with kms_region and policy_id
- [x] Migration job to populate evaluated_kms_region for existing resources
- [x] Unit + integration tests added
- [x] Docs for runbook and rollout steps added

Rollout notes: deploy control-plane changes first (api + policy service), run backfill migration during off-peak, flip feature flag to enforce in a canary region, monitor audit event rates and blocked-request dashboards, then global flip. See release_notes for operator steps.

Backward compatibility: the audit schema adds optional fields but remains backward compatible. The enforce path is behind a feature flag.

Related: builds on previous RBAC v2 audit work (see ENG-3100, pr-214812) and addresses incident SUP-1182 where a misconfigured replica pool routed requests to a regionally-incompatible KMS key.
